title: Bimatoprost as a Treatment for Graves' Orbitopathy
official: The Role of Bimatoprost in Graves' Periorbitopathy
summary: Testing whether Bimatoprost, a topical eye drop used for glaucoma, can be used to induce periorbital fat atrophy in patients with Graves' disease
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria: Graves' Ophthalmopathy with Exophthalmos/Proptosis -

Exclusion Criteria: Active Graves Disease, Currently pregnant, Taking Steroids
